skill.summary: Add causal reasoning to agent actions. Trigger on ANY high-level action with observable outcomes - emails, messages, calendar changes, file operations, API calls, notifications, reminders, purchases, deployments. Use for planning interventions, debugging failures, predicting outcomes, backfilling historical data for analysis, or answering "what happens if I do X?" Also trigger when reviewing past actions to understand what worked/failed and why.

latestVersion.changelog: Expanded triggers to all high-level actions, added backfill scripts for email/calendar/messages, broader domain coverage
